result.topic_en: Pencil calculations on boundary conditions at the edges $x=\pm a$, $y=\pm b$ of a rectangle for a function $w=ux+vy+u_1$ built from analytic functions (Cauchy–Riemann equations), with a parameter $r$, then rewritten in terms of a complex function $z$ of $p$, apparently in connection with an elasticity-type plate problem.
result.transcription:
$(u+vi)(x-yi)+u_1+v_1 i$ $\quad \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\quad \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=-\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}$
$ux+vy+u_1=w$ $\quad \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}=\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}x+\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial y^2}y+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}$
$x=\pm a$ $\Big|$ $\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}x+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial x^2}y+\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x^2}$ $\quad \frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x\partial y}x+\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial x\partial y}y$
$+(1-\frac{1}{r})\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}x+(1-\frac{1}{r})\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial y^2}y+2\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}(1-\frac{1}{r})+(1-\frac{1}{r})\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial y^2}$
$[-4-]\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}x-[-4-]\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x\partial y}y+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}(2r-[-1-])+[-4-]\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x^2}=0$
[-$\frac{\partial^3 u}{\partial x^2\partial y}x-\frac{\partial^3 u}{\partial x\partial y^2}y+2\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x\partial y}(2r-2)+\frac{\partial^3 u_1}{\partial x^2\partial y}=0$-]
[-$x=\pm a$ $\Big|$ $\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}x-\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}y+2w(2r-1)+\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x^2}=0$
$\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y}x-\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}y-4\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}(r+1)+\frac{\partial^3 u_1}{\partial x^2\partial y}=0$
$y=\pm b$ $\Big|$ $\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}y-\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}x+2w(2r-1)+\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial y^2}=0$-]
$\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y}y-\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}x-4\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}(r+1)+\frac{\partial^3 u_1}{\partial y\partial x^2}=0$
[-$\frac{\partial^3 u}{\partial x^3}x$ ...-]
$x=\pm a$ $\Big|$ $\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}x-\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}y+2w(2r-1)+\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x^2}=0$
$\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}x-\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y\partial x}y-[-\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}(r+1)-]+\frac{\partial^3 u_1}{\partial x^3}=0$
$y=\pm b$ $\Big|$ $\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}y-\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}x+2w(2r-1)+\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial y^2}=0$
$\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial y^2}y-\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y}x-\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}(4r+1)+\frac{\partial^3 u_1}{\partial y^3}=0$
$\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}i=\frac{\partial z}{\partial p}$ $\quad -p\frac{\partial z}{\partial p}=-x\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}-y\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}$
$\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial p^2}=\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x^2}-\frac{\partial^2 w}{\partial x\partial y}i$
$\frac{\partial z}{\partial p}(2x-p)+2z(2r-1)+z_1=g$
$\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial p^2}(2x-p)-\frac{\partial z}{\partial p}(4r+1)+\frac{\partial z_1}{\partial p}[-=\frac{\partial f}{\partial p}-]$ $\qquad \frac{\partial z}{\partial p}(2x-p)-4r[-z-]+z_1=f$
$\frac{\partial z}{\partial p}\begin{pmatrix}4r-3\\4r+1\end{pmatrix}$ $\qquad \frac{\partial z}{\partial p}(8r-2)[-=f-]=\frac{\partial g}{\partial p}-\frac{\partial f}{\partial p}$
$z=\frac{g-f}{8r-2}$ $\qquad \frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial p^2}$
